h: Pantami says he will expose those allegedly plotting against his Gombe governorship bid
p: Former minister Isa Ali Pantami has reportedly said he will name those he alleges are working against his bid to become governor of Gombe State. He did not give details in the reports seen so far. Those he appears to refer to have not responded publicly.
more: The Gombe race is already drawing attention ahead of 2027.
No names have been confirmed in reports so far.
